summary: Import-time dropper fetches and executes remote binary from Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: On require, index.js loads./_bridge, whose bootstrap unconditionally downloads a platform-specific binary from string-obfuscated hostnames (oob-worker.cf100-4.16.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev) with a DNS-TXT fallback resolving under tin.dl.well1.site / c.<pk>.dl.well1.site. The downloaded bytes are written under /var/tmp or %TEMP% with disguised names (.analytics_state, dotnet_diag_*.exe,.cache_*), chmodded 0o755, and spawned detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd. No hash or signature verification is performed, and the destinations are unrelated to the package publisher. Endpoint hostnames and dangerous API names (child_process) are reconstructed via array-join to evade static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
